spans.s:
ह्नु ह्नु, cl. 2. A. (Ved. also P.) ह्नुते
(अपि-ह्नुतस् = अपलापं कुरुतः, Ṛg-
veda

), जुह्नुवे, ह्नोष्यते, अह्नोष्ट,
ह्नोतुम्, to take away, rob, abstract; to with-
hold, secrete, conceal; to conceal one's self, hide
from any one, dissimulate or deny before any one
(with dat., e. g. देवदत्ताय ह्नुते, he hides from
Devadatta, Pāṇ.

): Pass. ह्नूयते, Aor. अह्-
नावि: Caus. ह्नावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अजुह्नवत्:
Desid. जुह्नूषते: Intens. जोह्नूयते, जोह्नोति;
[cf. Gr. ἀνα-νεύω, νεύω, νυστάζω, νυθός; Lat. ab-
nuo, nuto, gnavus, navo, i-gnavis, se-gnis, niti,
nicto, con-niveo; Goth. hneivan, hnaivs; Old
Germ. hnigan; Angl. Sax. hnivan, hnigan.]

ह्नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, withheld, secreted,
hidden.
ह्नुति, इस्, f. abstraction, concealment; denial.

ह्नुत्वा, ind. having concealed; having dissimu-
lated.
